bullets.note: ).** “Sonder _n._ the realization that each random passerby is living a life as vivid and complex as your own—populated with their own ambitions, friends, routines, worries and inherited craziness—an epic story that continues invisibly around you like an anthill sprawling deep underground, with elaborate passageways to thousands of other lives that you’ll never know existed, in which you might appear only once, as an extra sipping coffee in the background, as a blur of traffic passing on the highway, as a lighted window at dusk.” (Hat tip to [Jawad Mian](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/lmun74z88amhkw78e/deceh0h478q233/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9qc21pYW4=), who introduced me to this. I was trying to send him a picture, and I kept asking, “Did you get it yet?” to which he kept responding, “Not yet. It’s still loading….” After a few rounds of this, we had the following exchange:  
Kevin: “There is a non-zero chance you’re fucking with me and sending me a picture of a downloading symbol.”  
Tim: “Haha... I’m not! That’s a genius idea, though.”

And so, here we are in 5-Bullet Friday, and I offer you all [the official “Kevin Rose Loading Prank” image](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/lmun74z88amhkw78e/59bvh7hv9k5wvz/aHR0cHM6Ly9pLmltZ3VyLmNvbS9ZZTIyczNRLmpwZw==) of an iOS downloading symbol, which you can download and use. There are an infinite number of ways you can joyfully screw with your friends. Below are just a few examples, all of which can be followed with “Did you get it yet?,” “Let me resend,” and other taunts.  

“Dude, how the hell did you end up in the New York Post?!”  
\[send “Kevin Rose loading prank” image\]  
“Oof... I’m so sorry \[someone’s ex’s name\] posted that pic on Facebook :/”  
\[send “Kevin Rose loading prank” image\]  
“Did you see that crazy naked pic of \[celebrity crush they have\] floating around?”  
\[send “Kevin Rose loading prank” image\]

The opportunities for childish delight and wasting time are endless. Have fun!
